purpose: Teach: キロメートル/秒間/車掌/電柱/ノース/サウス/サッシ/リール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究対象地までの距離をキロメートルで記せ
lines.en: Ren — record the distance to the research site in kilometers.
lines.style: Direct, measured tone. Brief and authoritative without harshness. Expectation of compliance — not a question. Steady eye contact, slight forward lean.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験の秒間サンプリングを徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll ensure we stick to precise sampling at one-second intervals.
lines.style: Prompt, eager compliance. Slight breathiness from concentration. Standing a bit straighter. The tone of someone wanting to prove they've understood exactly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、鉄道輸送の車掌役割の研究を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the research on the conductor's role in rail transport operations.
lines.style: Same measured authority. Slight pause before the task — not rushed. Clear expectation. The voice of someone delegating because they believe the person can do it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。送電網の電柱配置の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through the papers on power grid pole placement.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Slightly uncertain—he's registering that this is different from what he expected, but committing anyway. No hesitation in the voice, just a micro-pause internally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、北極研究のノース極隊と連絡を取れ
lines.en: Ren — contact the Arctic Research team to coordinate.
lines.style: Same steady command. Matter-of-fact. The phrasing is clear; the expectation is clear. No inflection that softens it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。南極研究のサウス極隊の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the Antarctic Research team's publications.
lines.style: Acceptance without full comprehension. He's doing what's asked, but there's a slight flatness now — polite, attentive, but internally noting the mismatch.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のサッシ気密性を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the airtightness of the window seals in the lab.
lines.style: Crisp, practical instruction. No embellishment. The tone of routine maintenance paired with quiet authority. Direct as before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。撮影機材のリール調整を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll adjust and set the camera equipment reels.
lines.style: Final compliance. Slight weariness now—not exhaustion, but the accumulation of mismatched instructions. Quiet, steady. He's still performing correctly, but the mask is thinner.
